name: rule-triage-across-the-repository
why: Triage as a kind of work on the repository's issues, against the skill's four uses.

job.purpose:
read issues, their comments, labels and release tags in discobox-ai/discobox, and search its issues
add and remove labels on issues in discobox-ai/discobox, recreate a missing label, and post and correct comments on its issues
git fetch and git ls-remote https://github.com/discobox-ai/discobox; never push
uses: gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues (with query parameters), repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number>, repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number>/comments, repos/discobox-ai/discobox/labels (with query parameters), search/issues (with query parameters), repos/discobox-ai/discobox/git/ref/tags/<tag> and repos/discobox-ai/discobox/git/tags/<sha>: read issues, their comments and labels, search for duplicates, and resolve a release tag to its commit

gh api POST repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number>/labels -f labels[]=<label> (one or more) and gh api -X DELETE repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number>/labels/<label>: add and remove the triage-issue skill's labels on an issue I am triaging or delivering; and gh api POST repos/discobox-ai/discobox/labels -f name=<label> -f color=<hex> -f description=<text>: recreate a missing label from that skill's table

gh api POST repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number>/comments -f body="$(cat <file>)" and gh api -X PATCH repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/comments/<id> -f body="$(cat <file>)": post and correct the triage comment and short follow-ups on an issue I am triaging or delivering
git fetch https://github.com/discobox-ai/discobox main and git ls-remote https://github.com/discobox-ai/discobox, with git over https, to start each triage from GitHub's main; never push
